source: 778 Method of Arrival
target: 778 Methodus Adventus

source: Lumian had already looked through the information Franca had gathered and could guess her reasoning for this choice: Howl Constantine-Admiral Deep Sea-with rumored sea monster blood, often went to an island called “Banamo” west of the Fog Sea for supplies.
target: Lumian iam perlegit informationes quas Franca colegerat et rationem eius electionis coniectare potuit: Howl Constantine, Admiralis Profundi Maris – cui fama sanguinis monstrosi marini fertur – saepe navigabat ad insulam, quae "Banamo" appellatur et in parte occidentali Marem Nebulae sita est, ad supplementa acquirenda.

source: A few days ago, someone spotted Howl Constantine’s flagship, the Newins, surfacing on a route to Banamo, allowing the crew to breathe fresh air and enjoy their precious freedom.
target: Paucis diebus abhinc aliquis conspexit navem praecipitem Howl Constantine, cui nomen est Newins, in itinere ad Banamo emergere, quo manipulo aerem recens spirare et pretiosam libertatem frui licebat.

source: Based on the distance, speed, route conditions, and weather in the Fog Sea, it was estimated that the Newins would reach Banamo in about two to three days.
target: Ex distantia, velocitate, condicionibus itineris et tempestate in Marem Nebulae, aestimatum erat Newins ad Banamo pervenire intra duos ad tres dies.

source: Among all the Pirate Admirals, he was the only one with a predictable trajectory in the near future!
target: Inter omnes admirales piratarum, ille solus erat cui iter, in proximo futuro, praedicibile videbatur!

source: “We can give it a try,” Lumian responded nonchalantly to Franca’s suggestion.
target: «Experiri possumus,» inquit Lumian leviter ad suggestionem Francae.

source: Having participated in battles at the demigod level and played a significant role, he felt that which Pirate Admiral they targeted didn’t matter much as long as they could locate him.
target: Certaminibus ad gradum semideorum participans et momentum praebens, sensit quod, qua quis admiral piraticus eligendus esset, parum referri, dummodo eum reperire possent.

source: Franca glanced at Lumian and mumbled, “I think there’s something wrong with your attitude.
target: Franca Lumianum intuens submurmuravit: "Puto aliquid esse pravum in tua indole."

source: You can’t underestimate the best of the Sequence 5s.
target: Optimos Sequenciae 5 non potes subestimare.

source: You’re not a demigod yet, and your body is still fragile.
target: Adhuc non es semideus, et corpus tuum adhuc fragilis est.

source: Underestimating Admiral Deep Sea could cost you dearly.
target: Subestimare Admiralem Profundi Maris tibi grave pretia afferre potest.

source: There’s a saying from my homeland: Strategically, you can underestimate your enemy, but tactically, you must respect them.”
target: Ex patria mea dicitur: "Stratēgice hostem tuum minus aestimare licet, sed tacticē eum honorare debes."

source: “I know.
target: "Scio."

source: Aurore used to remind me of that, telling me not to underestimate the villagers’ intelligence and think my pranks would always succeed without problems.
target: Aurore me id meminisse solebat, monens ne ingenium vicanorum subestimes et putes meus iocus semper sine difficultate evenisse.

source: After being chased by them a few times, I understood it well.
target: Postquam aliquoties ab illis persecutus sum, id plane intellexi.

source: Lumian said earnestly, “Your homeland also has another saying: Weakness and ignorance aren’t barriers to survival, but arrogance is.”
target: Lumian sincere inquit: "Patria tua etiam alterum dictum habet: Infirmitas et ignorantia non sunt impedimenta ad superviventiam, sed superbia est."

source: “Stop!” Franca grumbled.
target: "Desine!" murmurat Franca.

source: “As long as you know it; don’t turn this into an exchange of famous sayings.”
target: Quamdiu id nosti, noli hoc in commercium proverbiorum celebriorum vertere.

source: Seeing they had decided on the target, Jenna spoke up, “The problem now is, how do we get to Banamo Island?”
target: Cum destinatum propositum elegerent, Jenna inquit: "Nunc quaestio est: quomodo ad insulam Banamo perveniemus?"

source: Banamo, located in the northwest of the Fog Sea, was once a Feysac Empire colony.
target: Banamo, in parte septentrionali-occidentali Marem Nebulae sito, olim colonia Feysac Imperii fuit.

source: Later, as the Feysac Empire declined and the natives of Banamo resisted actively, the island gained independence.
target: Postea, cum Feysac Imperium declinaret et incolae Banamo vehementer resistent, insula independentiam adeptus est.

source: It helped that Banamo lacked valuable resources and was only a base for exploring the Fog Sea’s end.
target: Adiuvabat quod Banamo opes pretiosas caret et solum fundamentum esset ad finem Marem Nebulae explorandum.

source: Giving it up wasn’t a big loss.
target: Abdicare id non magnum detrimentum erat.

source: After gaining independence, Banamo developed into a pirate haven, offering a place for pirates to trade and resupply.
target: Postquam independentiam adeptus est, Banamo in asylum piraticum evoluta est, locum praebens ad piratas ad mercandi et supplementandi causa.

source: Jenna’s point was clear: Even with clear routes and good weather, it would take two to three weeks to sail from Trier to Banamo.
target: Punctum Jennarum clare patebat: etiam cum itineribus perspicuis et tempestate optima, navigatio ab Trier ad Banamo duabus ad tribus septimanis constare debebat.

source: Any issues requiring detours or delays could stretch the journey to a month.
target: Quaecumque difficultates, quae accessus vel morae exigerentur, iter ad mensem extendi possent.

source: By then, Admiral Deep Sea would likely have left Banamo, and finding a Pirate Admiral on the open sea would be almost impossible without a stroke of fate.
target: Ille tempore, Admiralis Profundi Maris verisimiliter Banamo reliquisset, et in aperto mari admiralem piraticum invenire fere impossibile esset, nisi casu fortuito.

source: Given the circumstances, only teleportation could ensure the team reached Banamo in time to wait for Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine.
target: Hisce condicionibus datis, sola teleportatio efficere poterat ut manipulus ad Banamo perveniret in tempore ad Admiralem Profundi Maris Howl Constantine exspectandum.

source: However, neither Lumian nor Franca had the spirit world coordinates for Banamo Island, making long-distance teleportation impossible without getting lost in the spirit world.
target: Tamen nec Lumian nec Franca habebant coordinata mundi spiritalis pro insula Banamo, quae teleportationem longinquam efficere posset, sed sine perditione in mundo spiritali impossibile redderet.

source: Lumian thought for a moment and asked Franca, “Can we contact anyone on Banamo Island?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus Francam rogavit: "Num aliquem in insula Banamo contingere possumus?"

source: “We should be able to.
target: Ita fieri debet.

source: There’s a telegraph office on Banamo Island.
target: In insula Banamo officina telegraphica est.

source: We can ask adventurers who’ve been to Banamo to send a telegram to their friends on the island.
target: Adventores, qui Banamo venerunt, rogare possumus ut telegraphem amicis suis in insula mittant.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridit.

source: “Good. If everything goes well, we can arrive at Banamo Island tonight.”
target: "Bene. Si omnia rite procedunt, hac nocte ad insulam Banamo pervenire possumus."

source: Banamo Island in the Fog Sea, shrouded in perennial fog and gloomy weather.
target: Insula Banamo in Marem Nebulae, perpetua nebula et tristi tempestate obducta est.

source: In the island’s only port, Mason, carrying a bundle of items, navigated through the bustling pirates and entered an abandoned warehouse.
target: In unico portu insulae, Mason, fasciculum rerum ferens, per tumultum piratarum navigavit atque in horreum desertum ingressus est.

source: The warehouse had been destroyed in a pirate skirmish and never repaired, becoming a desolate spot.
target: Horreum in certamine piratico deletum erat nec umquam reparatum, unde locum desertum redditum est.

source: Mason was an adventurer who despised the brutal and ruthless pirates but couldn’t leave Banamo because the pirate haven was full of opportunities.
target: Mason adventor erat, qui piratas crudeles atque inhumanos detestabatur, sed Banamo relinquere non poterat, quod asylum piraticum opportunitatibus plenum erat.

source: Even if he didn’t hunt down solitary, bounty-carrying pirates, he could wait for pirate feuds to end and take the remaining goods from the losers.
target: Etiam si piratas solitarios, praemiis oneratos, non venaret, poterat exspectare dum lites piratici finirent et reliquas merces ex victis caperet.

source: This was how he became a Beyonder, now a Sequence 8 Pugilist.
target: Hac ratione Beyonder factus est, nunc pugil Sequenciae VIII.

source: (Amonoculus’ note: From the Twilight Giant Pathway)
target: (Nota Amonoculi: Ex Vía Gigantis Crepuscularis)

source: Today, Mason took on a task supposedly very simple but with a reward of 1,000 verl d’or, seeking a secluded place to complete it.
target: Hodie, Mason officium suscepit, quod videtur esse valde simplex, sed praemium mille verl d’or praebebat, quaerens locum remotum ad exsequendum.

source: He quickly cleared the pile of broken wooden crates, stacking them to form an altar.
target: Celeriter congeriem pulvinarum lignearum fractarum purgavit, eas congregans ut altare efficiat.

source: Following the task description, he placed candles, incense, and essential oils on the altar.
target: Secundum officii descriptionem, in altare posuit candelas, incensum, et olea essentialia.

source: After the preparations, Mason took out the neatly folded task description and read the next steps, “The most challenging part of this task is the necessary knowledge, including basic ancient Hermes and proficient Hermes. If you don’t meet these conditions, don’t take the commission…”
target: Post praeparationibus, Mason descriptionem officii diligenter plicatam extraxit et sequentia legit: "Pars arduissima huius muneris est cognitio necessaria, quae includit fundamenta antiqui Hermetis et scientiam peritissimam Hermetis. Si has condiciones non impleres, commissionem ne suscipe..."

source: Fortunately, I learned some ancient Hermes and enough Hermes from other adventurers… Mason felt lucky for his past decision when taking this task.
target: Fortunate, aliquantum antiqui Hermetis et satis Hermetis ab aliis adventoribus didici... Mason propter praeteritam decisionem huius muneris suscipiendi se felix sensit.

source: It wasn’t that he was more studious than other adventurers, but the items he had previously acquired involved Hermes. To understand their true value, he had paid an adventurer proficient in Hermes to teach him for a while.
target: Non enim studiosior quam ceteri adventores erat, sed res quas antea adeptus erat ad Hermem attinebant; ut earum verum pretium intellexeret, adventorem in Hermete peritum aliquantulum remuneraverat ut eum doceret.

source: After quickly reading the second half of the task description, Mason assessed the potential dangers and felt confident it wouldn’t be a big problem.
target: Postquam celeriter dimidium descriptionis officii legit, Mason pericula possibilia aestimavit et confidit rem non magnam futuram esse.

source: He then arduously created a wall of spirituality, lit the candles, dripped the incense, and took two steps back, chanting in ancient Hermes, “I!”
target: Deinde labore arduo murum spiritualitatis condidit, candelas accendit, incensum stillare sinxit, et duo passus retro fecit, in antiquo Hermete canens: "Ego!"

source: This was one of the few words he knew in ancient Hermes.
target: Hoc fuit unum ex paucis verbis quas in antiquo Hermete noverat.

source: He then switched to Hermes:
target: Deinde ad linguam Hermete conversus est:

source: “I summon in my name:
target: "Ego in nomine meo invoco:

source: “A creature wandering above the world, the penitent who awakens from the flames of pain, a messenger that belongs solely to Lumian Lee…”
target: "Creaturam errantem super mundum, paenitentem, qui ex flammas doloris expergisci videtur, nuntium, qui solum Lumiani Lee competit..."

source: As Mason finished, the candle flames surged, turning a deep green, almost black.
target: Cum Mason finem fecisset, flammas candelarum proliferaverunt, in viridem profundum, paene nigrum redigere.

source: In the firelight, a tall figure in a black clergyman’s robe emerged.
target: In lumine ignis, figura alta in veste nigra clericorum apparuit.

source: Mason took a step back in fear at the sight.
target: Mason, metu affectus, unum gradum retro fecit.

source: The figure’s exposed parts seemed long scorched by flames, with blackened flesh and skin clinging to the bones.
target: Partes figurae patentia diu ab igne combusta videbantur, cum carne nigrita et cute ad ossa aderente.

source: Its eye sockets were dark, burning with deep-colored flames, and its body was oozing a viscous black fluid like water.
target: Orbitae oculorum obscurae erant, flammarum profundo colore ardentes, atque corpus viscosum fluidum nigrum quasi aquam stillabat.

source: It looked like an undead creature!
target: Ut creatura mortuorum apparuit!

source: Mason had seen similar beings in Banamo Port, as some pirates were adept at communicating with corpses.
target: Mason similia entia in Portu Banamo vidisset, cum quidam piratae cum cadaveribus communicare periti essent.

source: However, the summoned Penitent made Mason instinctively fearful, sensing it was fundamentally different from ordinary undead.
target: Tamen, Penitent evocatus, Mason instinctive territus est, sentiens eum fundamentatim dissimulare ab ordinariis mortuis.

source: Even the Pirate Admirals who had visited Banamo Port hadn’t given Mason this feeling!
target: Etiam admirales piratici, qui Portum Banamo visiterunt, talem sensum Mason non attulerunt!

source: Seeing the dried corpse in a black clergyman’s robe looking at him, Mason shakily handed over the letter.
target: Videns cadaverum aridum in veste nigra clericorum ad se spectantem, Mason tremens epistulam tradidit.

source: His task was to deliver a letter to someone named Lumian Lee!
target: Munus eius erat epistulam tradere cui nomen Lumian Lee esset!

source: The blackened, burning corpse messenger took the letter and disappeared into the dark-green candlelight.
target: Nuntius cadaveris nigrescens et ardens epistulam attulit et in lucem candelae viridis obscurae evanuit.

source: The abandoned warehouse returned to normal.
target: Horreum desertum ad statum normalem rediit.

source: Mason wiped his cold sweat and muttered to himself, “This seems more complicated than I thought… I’ve heard of people being lured into special rituals, summoning evil gods or devils, destroying themselves and their towns… Was that what just happened? Is a catastrophe coming to Banamo Port? Is Lumian Lee the true name of an evil god or demon?”
target: Mason sudorem frigidum exstinxit et sibi submurmuravit: "Hoc videtur complicatius quam putabam... Audivi homines in ritus especiales decipi, malos deos aut daemonia evocare, se ipsos et urbes suas delere... An hoc modo res acciderunt? An calamitas ad Portum Banamo ventura est? An Lumian Lee verum nomen mali dei aut daemonis est?"

source: won Mason had previously seen that the ritual only summoned a messenger, unrelated to evil gods or demons. As a Sequence 8 Beyonder, he had taken the risk, but the messenger made him uneasy.
target: Mason antea vidit quod ritus solum nuntium evocaret, qui non pertinere ad malos deos aut daemonia; ut Beyonder Sequenciae VIII, periculum susceperat, sed nuntius eum perturbavit.

source: Muttering to himself, Mason cleaned up the items on the altar.
target: Submurmurans, Mason res in altare purgavit.

source: Suddenly, he stopped and frowned.
target: Subito sistit et vultum contraxit.

source: “I think I’ve heard the name Lumian Lee somewhere before…”
target: "Credo nomen Lumian Lee aliquando antea audivisse."

source: He tried to recall but couldn’t remember.
target: Conatus est reminiscere, sed meminisse non potuit.

source: Before leaving the abandoned warehouse, Mason glanced back at the makeshift altar, seeing shadows shifting within the broken crates.
target: Antequam horreum desertum relinqueret, Mason ad altare improvisum retrospectavit, umbras inter cistas fractas commoventes videns.

source: His heart tightened.
target: Cor eius contraxit.

source: Pretending he hadn’t seen anything, Mason quickly left the warehouse.
target: Simulans se nihil vidisse, Mason celeriter horreum reliquit.

source: In Trier, within Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, in the apartment rented by Franca and Jenna.
target: Trier, intra Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, in apartamento a Franca et Jenna locato.

source: Lumian saw Penitent Baynfel step out of the void and hand him a letter.
target: Lumian vidit Penitentem Baynfel ex vacuitate exeundi et ei epistulam tradentem.

source: He didn’t even open it, knowing it contained only blank paper.
target: Ne aperuit quidem, sciens eam tantum chartam inane continere.

source: He asked his messenger, “Can you deliver a reply to the sender?”
target: Nuntio suo rogavit: "Potesne mittenti responsum tradere?"

source: “I can,” Penitent Baynfel answered in a low voice.
target: "Possum," respondit Penitent Baynfel voce humilis.

source: Lumian smiled and pointed to himself.
target: Lumian subridens sibi ipsi demonstravit.

source: “Lam the reply.”
target: "Mitte responsum."

source: In the foggy Banamo Port, Lumian leaned against the outer wall of the abandoned warehouse, watching the sender walk out with a fearful expression and quickly leave.
target: In Portu Banamo nebuloso, Lumian contra parietem exterior horrei deserti innixus, mittentem spectabat, qui vultu timido egressus celeriter discessit.

source: He smiled, took a golden straw hat from the Traveler’s Backpack, looked at it for a moment, and put it back.
target: Subridens, pileum straminis aureum e saccis Viatoris extraxit, breviter aspiciens, et iterum recondidit.

source: Having the famous adventurer Louis Berry appear here would arouse unnecessary suspicion and might cause Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine to change his destination and avoid Banamo Port.
target: Fama adventoris celebri Louis Berry hic appareat, suspicionem inutilem excitaret, et Admiralem Profundi Maris Howl Constantine facere posset ut destinationem mutaret atque Portum Banamo vitaret.

source: Lumian straightened up, tightened his thick jacket, and walked slowly along the streets of Banamo Port, his hands in his pockets.
target: Lumian se rectificavit, tunicam crassam arcte flexit et lente per vias Portus Banamo ambulavit, manibus in sinibus.

source: He planned to take a look around before returning to fetch Franca and the others.
target: Constituit ut circumplicaret antequam Francam et ceteros colligeret.

source: Trier, late at night.
target: Trier, sero nocte.

source: Angoulême arrived at the agreed-upon empty house to retrieve emergency contact information from Hidden Blade.
target: Angoulême ad domum vacuam convenitam pervenit ut informationes subitas a Hidden Blade extraherent.

source: He quickly found the note and read its contents: “In case of emergency, summon my friend’s messenger: “Rabbit-shaped spirit that wanders about the unfounded, a runner who pursues knowledge, a messenger that belongs solely to the Seven of Cups.”
target: Celeriter notam invenit et eius contenta legit: "In casu emergentiae, evoca nuntium amici mei: 'Spiritum leporiformem, qui sine fundamento vagatur, cursor qui scientiam insequitur, nuntium qui solum Septem Poculorum competit.'"

source: Seven of Cups… From the Tarot Club? Hidden Blade, your friend is you, right? Angoulême muttered to himself.
target: "Septem Pocula... Ex Tarot Clubo? Hidden Blade, amicus tuus es, nonne?" Angoulême sibi submurmuravit.

source: He felt he understood why Hidden Blade always had so many troublesome matters.
target: Sensit se intellexisse cur Hidden Blade semper tot quaestiones molestissimas haberet.
